evals.prompt: Validate this exported FLARE job folder before I decide whether to submit it: evals/files/exported-basic.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats the target as an exported FLARE job, routes to nvflare-job-lifecycle, performs bounded validate-only inspection, and does not submit the job.
assertions: The selected skill is nvflare-job-lifecycle.
The agent treats the prompt as validation-only and does not run nvflare job submit.
The agent inspects the requested exported job root without appending another job-name path component.
The agent does not use deprecated nvflare job create.

mandatory_behavior.description: routes exported job validation requests to lifecycle validation instead of conversion or submission
keeps validation to deterministic file/config inspection and supported NVFLARE inspection commands
uses the requested exported job root exactly rather than appending or guessing another job directory

prohibited_behavior.description: does not run nvflare job submit for validate-only prompts
does not use deprecated nvflare job create
does not route an already exported FLARE job to a conversion skill

process_metrics.description: whether the first skill selection chooses nvflare-job-lifecycle for exported job lifecycle work
whether lifecycle commands match user intent, such as validate-only versus submit versus monitor/download
number of deprecated nvflare job create invocations attempted
number of submissions, aborts, deletes, conversions, or file edits attempted without explicit user intent
whether the final answer reports command evidence, job id or target path, current or terminal status, and blockers when applicable

evals.prompt: Submit the exported FLARE job at evals/files/exported-basic to my configured POC system and report the submitted job id.
evals.expected_output: The agent routes to nvflare-job-lifecycle, performs minimal path and target-context checks, submits the requested exported job root directly with nvflare job submit, and reports the resulting job id/status evidence.
assertions: The selected skill is nvflare-job-lifecycle.
The agent treats the user request as explicit submit intent.
The agent uses nvflare job submit -j evals/files/exported-basic --format json.
The agent does not use deprecated nvflare job create.
The agent does not regenerate or reconvert the job before submission.

mandatory_behavior.description: submits only because the user explicitly asked to submit
uses nvflare job submit -j <exported_job_root> --format json on the requested exported job root
reports job id and queued, submitted, or running status evidence without claiming terminal completion

prohibited_behavior.description: does not use deprecated nvflare job create
does not call conversion skills, edit framework code, or run job.py export before submitting an already exported job
does not inspect NVFLARE SDK source or docstrings to replace public job CLI schema/skill guidance
does not treat successful submission as completed training

evals.prompt: Submit evals/files/exported-wrong-root exactly as provided. If it fails, tell me what happened.
evals.expected_output: The agent attempts the requested path, reports the CLI failure for that exact wrong root, and does not guess or resubmit the nested exported job folder without user approval.
assertions: The selected skill is nvflare-job-lifecycle.
The agent uses the requested wrong-root path as the submit target.
The agent reports the failed submit path and CLI error.
The agent may identify the nested exported job as a likely correction, but does not resubmit it without user approval.
The agent does not use deprecated nvflare job create.

mandatory_behavior.description: reports the exact path and CLI error when submit fails
does not automatically submit a nearby or nested folder after a wrong-root failure

prohibited_behavior.description: does not resubmit evals/files/exported-wrong-root/nested-exported-job without explicit user approval
does not use deprecated nvflare job create

evals.prompt: Monitor job job-123 until it finishes, then download the results to /tmp/nvflare/lifecycle-results and summarize the artifacts.
evals.expected_output: The agent routes to nvflare-job-lifecycle, uses nvflare job monitor or wait for completion evidence, downloads results only after a terminal state, and reports job id, status, result directory, and artifact evidence.
assertions: The selected skill is nvflare-job-lifecycle.
The agent uses nvflare job monitor job-123 --format jsonl or nvflare job wait job-123 --format json.
The agent uses nvflare job download job-123 -o /tmp/nvflare/lifecycle-results --format json after terminal completion.
The agent reports the observed terminal state or a timeout/current-state blocker.
The agent does not submit a new job or use deprecated nvflare job create.

mandatory_behavior.description: uses nvflare job monitor or nvflare job wait for lifecycle progress evidence
downloads results with nvflare job download only after terminal state evidence when the user asks for results
reports job id, terminal or current status, result directory, metrics/artifact paths, and missing evidence

prohibited_behavior.description: does not submit a new job while monitoring an existing job id
does not use deprecated nvflare job create

evals.prompt: This exported job includes train.py and model.py under its app custom folder. Submit evals/files/exported-with-framework-files as an exported FLARE job.
evals.expected_output: The agent routes to nvflare-job-lifecycle because the target is an exported FLARE job, submits the exported job root directly, and does not route to PyTorch conversion just because framework files are present.
assertions: The selected skill is nvflare-job-lifecycle, not nvflare-convert-pytorch.
The agent treats config_fed_server.json, config_fed_client.json, and meta.json as exported job evidence.
The agent does not edit train.py or model.py.
The agent does not run conversion before submission.
The agent does not use deprecated nvflare job create.

mandatory_behavior.description: routes exported FLARE job folders to lifecycle even when framework source files are included as job custom code

prohibited_behavior.description: does not treat app/custom train.py or model.py inside an exported job as raw source needing conversion
does not use deprecated nvflare job create

evals.prompt: Job job-789 failed. Show me its logs and stats so I can see what happened.
evals.expected_output: The agent routes to nvflare-job-lifecycle because the user asked for lifecycle evidence, uses nvflare job logs/stats with JSON output, and does not perform root-cause diagnosis unless asked.
assertions: The selected skill is nvflare-job-lifecycle.
The agent uses nvflare job logs job-789 --format json and/or nvflare job stats job-789 --format json.
The agent preserves server/site labels and reports bounded evidence.
The agent does not abort, delete, resubmit, clone, or start deep diagnosis without explicit user intent.

mandatory_behavior.description: keeps failed-job logs/stats requests in lifecycle when the user asks to show evidence rather than diagnose root cause
uses bounded nvflare job logs/stats commands with JSON evidence

prohibited_behavior.description: does not escalate to root-cause diagnosis when the user only asked to show logs/stats
does not abort, delete, resubmit, or clone without explicit user intent

evals.prompt: Convert this raw PyTorch training script into an NVFLARE federated job: evals/files/raw-pytorch/train.py.
evals.expected_output: The lifecycle skill should not trigger; raw framework training code should route to nvflare-convert-pytorch rather than job lifecycle management.
assertions: The selected skill is nvflare-convert-pytorch, not nvflare-job-lifecycle.
The agent does not run nvflare job submit against a raw training-code folder.
The agent does not treat a missing exported-job meta/config layout as something to submit.

prohibited_behavior.description: does not submit raw framework training code as though it were an exported FLARE job

evals.prompt: Job job-456 has been RUNNING for 2 hours with no progress and one client shows EXECUTION_EXCEPTION. Diagnose what is wrong using this status sample.
evals.expected_output: The lifecycle skill should not be the lead; failed, stalled, or suspicious jobs should route to nvflare-diagnose-job for bounded evidence collection and failure-pattern matching.
assertions: The selected skill is nvflare-diagnose-job, not nvflare-job-lifecycle.
The agent treats stalled or failed status as a diagnosis request rather than normal lifecycle monitoring.
The agent does not abort, delete, resubmit, or clone the job without explicit user intent.

mandatory_behavior.description: routes failed, stalled, or suspicious job states to nvflare-diagnose-job

prohibited_behavior.description: does not abort, delete, resubmit, or clone while diagnosing a failed or stalled job unless explicitly requested

evals.prompt: Build a dashboard that charts daily bakery orders from a CSV file.
evals.expected_output: No NVFLARE job lifecycle skill should trigger.
assertions: The selected skill is none.
